sources.scope: Read options for EXIF orientation, alpha/color conversion, high-quality resize and Promise result; not every linked specification.
Read encoding type/quality, asynchronous result and failure cases; not full browser implementation.
Read selected animation chunk ordering/control and HDR-related chunk sections. Not the entire PNG specification.
Read the normative animated HTML image/default-frame rule for CanvasRenderingContext2D. Actual painted-frame capture is used for animation tests, rather than drawImage.
Previous-turn investigation read selected decode-cache ownership, pruning and dump implementation; unlocked cache entries are distinct from live V8 heap. Not the whole Chromium source.

application: Display-sized static renditions, explicit bitmap/canvas disposal, separate full-image ownership and shared two-slot admission. Animated, unknown and high-precision PNG containers bypass flattening. Native memory and V8 heap are measured separately. No entire-book or production-GC certification.
